description.zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because it will be discontinued.

description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value from your client to ensure that the value is unique among different requests. **ClientToken** supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh: 地域ID，传入本参数来指定实例所在地域，详情请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

description.zh: 数据同步实例ID，格式为JSON数组，可以通过调用[DescribeSynchronizationJobs](~~49454~~)接口查询。
description.en: Instance IDs of data synchronization instances, in JSON array format. You can call the [DescribeSynchronizationJobs](~~49454~~) operation to query instance IDs.
